name: The Trollbane trial's Paragons and their guards are spawned where Ascension has them
contract: Hardcore - Trollbane (challenge 214, Prestige 428) requires killing Vazul 254168 before level 40, Zazera 254170 before 45 and Yahola 254169 before 59; none of them existed. Ascension footage and in-game .gps place Vazul (level 40 elite) in the Witherbark Village cave with two Elite Witherbark Headhunters 254176 (34-35), Zazera (45) on the Sandsorrow Watch tower in Tanaris, and Yahola (59) on the Mazra'Alor temple steps with the Left and Right Hand of Yahola 254172/254173 (59). Zazera took 13480 damage to kill on Ascension (with overkill), matching her cached health modifier 9.0 (13302 on these base stats); Vazul keeps her cached 9.0 (11034). Yahola has 68290 base health on Ascension, 3.2029 times her cached modifier. Asserted from the world phase at each spot: the Paragon is there once at her level with her model and health and can be attacked, and her guards are there at theirs.
